Unseen PredatorWhile in brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack. Leaping while at 0 Ferocity generates @f5@ Ferocity.

At @f1@ Ferocity, his next ability is empowered. Casting an empowered ability increases Rengar's Move Speed by @f3@% for @f4@ seconds.

Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace.

All Ferocity is lost upon exiting combat (represented by Unseen Predator's cooldown).

mLocKeys.keySummary:
While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack.

Rengar generates Ferocity whenever he casts an ability. At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered.

Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace, granting bonus attack damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
While in Brush, Rengar leaps to enemies he Attacks.

Rengar generates 1 Ferocity when he uses a non-ultimate Ability. At the start of the leap Unseen Predator will generate 1 Ferocity if none of his current Ferocity was generated this way.

At @MaxFerocity@ Ferocity, his next non-ultimate Ability is empowered. Casting an empowered Ability grants Rengar @EmpoweredMS@ Move Speed for @EmpoweredMSDuration@ seconds.

Unique takedowns increase Rengar's Attack Damage from Bonetooth Necklace.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_RengarPassive_Tooltip}}

Rengar loses all Ferocity after being out of combat for @InCombatTimer@ seconds.
Rengar gains extra Attack Damage for killing Kha'Zix.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Rengar's predatory instincts take over, <font color='#cd90ee'>Camouflaging</font> him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him. During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Rengar will also leap Attack when Camouflaged.

Active: Rengar gains @StealthMS@% Move Speed and True Sight in a small area around the nearest enemy champion for @StealthDuration@ seconds.

After @FadeTime@ seconds, Rengar becomes Camouflaged and can leap without being in Brush. Leaping to the nearest champion deals an additional @BonusDamage@ physical damage, shreds @ArmorShred@ Armor for @ArmorShredDuration@ seconds, and ends this Ability.
